description: Sine amplitude 0.25 (of the rest length 8, so 2) with the default frequency 1, phase 0 and falloffs 0.2: y = 2 sin(2 pi u) wherever the envelope is 1, which is u from 0.2 to 0.8. Points (2,2), (4,0), (6,-2); the envelope is 0 at both ends so those stay at y = 0 with slope 0. The slope dy/du = 4 pi cos(2 pi u) is 0 at u = 0.25 and 0.75 and -4 pi at 0.5, so the middle joint turns atan2(-4 pi, 8) = -57.5183 degrees.
